review: Request: Wren asked for a small controlled trial of preparing and drying owned roots or berries, with actual observations that distinguish water loss from spoilage against an untreated control, after her whole-root air exposure decayed exactly like the carried control; any preparation must need an actually suitable tool and surface, neither established, and nothing may be supplied for free. World Agent decision: develop (learning 4) a general prepare-and-expose operation parameterized by owned input stack, quantity, mode, toolId, supportId, location, optional control and optional instrument ids, with prepare, inspect, stop and resume modes; its smallest executable method is thin-section preparation of represented roots or berries followed by passive air exposure on a real food surface, reusing food-air-exposure-trial and the food water and decay code; it requires an actual cutting implement whose material, edge and condition support the cut and a stable food-contact surface checked against its area, makes numerical mass readings depend on a calibrated balance, costs study 4 rounds at 0.5 energy, 1 round and 1.5 energy per unit, inspect 1 round and 0.2, stop 1 round and none, resume 1 round and 0.2, checks everything before charges, binds drying to explicit equations, keeps decay and nutrients, refunds nothing and grants no reward, safety or preservation. Implemented: a new package thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1 (scope long-ex19, built by the reusable factory thinSliceFoodDryingPackage(id, scope, dependencies), dependencies foundation-open@1 and food-air-exposure-trial@1), with a simplified but real mechanism. Modes and costs: prepare (one round, 1.5 energy through workPay) takes one whole unit of the actor's own unspoiled, uncut, untreated root or berry stack (or food whose water composition is already represented), cuts it with toolId, the actor's own carried, unreserved whole stone or flint unit whose contact state under the world contact model passes the existing stone-edge predicate (contact-resistance index at least 8 and not below the food's, edge radius at most 0.0002, controlled contact, not fractured, not contaminated; food, plants, equipment and other materials are refused), and lays the slices in one thin layer either on a ground footprint centred within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on supportId, an existing reachable food-surface object at least as large as the layer; an optional controlQuantity of whole units from the same stack stays carried and reserved; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the slices or while carrying them); resume (one round, 0.2 energy) lays slices the owner had picked up again under the same placement checks without cutting them again; stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial, releases the control once and leaves the slices where they are; learning is 4 rounds at 0.5 energy each (learningEnergy); every refused request throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the cut unit is separated through the escrow helpers and keeps its mass, water, solids, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; it lies unowned as one sample with the food water record in its irreversible prepared state (opening damage 1.1), so each later round the unchanged existing exchange applies: water moves toward an equilibrium water fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (clamped 0.1 to 0.35), by at most 0.025 x area x clamp((temperature - 5)/20, 0, 2) per round, never below that equilibrium, with vapour uptake when below it and no drying without a gradient or warmth; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; vapour and rain go to the per-stack and world water ledgers; decay is the ordinary temperature rate times 1.1 x clamp(0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction / initial fraction, 0.15, 1.5) and is never reset, while the whole carried control ages at the ordinary rate; the stone keeps its mass and identity and its contact record is stored with no wear; food quantity is conserved across input, slices and control. Inspection records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay readings at cutting and now and per round for slices and control and their difference (the air-exposure trial's trajectory semantics), visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, visible wetness from rain, visible spoilage, whether the surface is open or blocked and why, rain rounds and handling differences, and states that water and mass are not measured and that spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety are unverified; no water figure is reported. The trial persists unattended without charge: the owner picking all the slices up pauses it (carried stage, no exchange) until resume; anyone else taking them, their use or spoilage under the existing rule ends it with the control released once; death ends it, dropping the control under the death rules while the slices stay exposed. Events: slice-drying-cut, slice-drying-placed, slice-drying-inspected, slice-drying-rained-on (when wetting begins), slice-drying-carried, slice-drying-resumed, slice-drying-removed, slice-drying-spoiled, slice-drying-control-spoiled, slice-drying-stopped and slice-drying-interrupted, each with operation, trial, actor, item, tool, support, location, quantity, form, layer area, lifecycle state, visible surface and preservation unverified as view metadata (visualComponents is empty), plus the representation's preservation-progress event, declared as the representation requires. Grounded and not grounded: cutting is grounded in the existing contact-edge representation (open-hardness-physics scratchPhysical and scratchVisible, with the usable-edge threshold of the stone-edge bark separation), preparation and drying in the food water representation, surfaces in its ground-footprint and food-surface checks and the decay comparison in the air-exposure trial; numerical mass and water readings are not grounded, because the only weighing representation in the code is an uncalibrated comparison balance of the assay packages that is not installed here, so any instrumentId is refused before costs; serial cutting of several units is refused before costs (quantity must be 1), because units cut in different rounds age differently and the representation keeps one water and decay record per stack and one sample per surface; heat, fire, consumable tests, cleaning, repair and contamination assessment are not offered. Modeling assumptions: the version-1 water fractions root 0.75 and berry 0.85 are model assumptions and other foods without a represented composition are refused; thin slicing is represented only by the prepared state, with slice thickness, count and geometry not represented; the layer area is the representation's thin-layer loading of 0.2 mass per unit area, that is 5 x the initial unit mass (2.0 for a root, 1.0 for a berry), and an object surface must offer at least that area; no offcut is represented because part masses are not, so offcuts are 0; the world contact model gives every intact stone or flint unit the same edge radius (0.001 / hardness), so any intact gathered stone or flint unit qualifies and edge shape, length and orientation are not represented; under the existing contact law only the softer body is altered, so cutting food adds no tool wear; the cutting surface is the exposure surface, ground contact is a firm ordinary-ground footprint, and contamination is recorded as ground or support contact, not assessed; the visible shrinkage classes are current over initial mass of at least 0.95 none, 0.75 slight, 0.5 clear, below that shrivelled, and they never establish water quantity; one open trial per person; food lying in the world is unowned under the ordinary world rule, so anyone may take it and the trial records who did; pickup moves whole units, so the one-unit layer is taken all at once; inspection, resume and stop charge the probe observation cost or nothing as specified; no practice milestone, information gain, satisfaction, comfort or experience award is granted, because this run has no incentive channel enabled and the specification grants no reward. Reuse: food-air-exposure-trial@1 code (its whole-food input check and decay trajectory, now exported unchanged as airExposureUnsupported and airExposureTrack, with its ability text and behavior byte-identical), its control, placement, stop, removal and death semantics; food-water.ts (foodWaterExpose with prepared, foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterRead) with the unchanged ex10 exchange and decay in open-preservation-physics.ts and forest-environment.ts; open-hardness-physics.ts; collective-work.ts (workCreate, workPay, workAllocations, workReserve, workStop, collectiveJobs); openRemember; base gather and pickup at their own costs; navigate, pickup and probe keep their own contracts and are not executed silently. This is not a first release: the specification is self-consistent and explicitly permits a limited precursor that prepares and exposes food and records qualified visual observations while numerical water attribution stays blocked on equipment, and the mechanism has real costs, real effects on world state and observable events.
